_note: Sidecar for the v0.1.21 Virgin Voyages Brilliant Lady hosted solo group pack (Miami, Nov 30 - Dec 10 2026; St. Maarten, Tortola, St. Croix, San Juan, Puerto Plata, Bimini Beach Club). Built 2026-10-05 from three read-only research passes plus checks in the main session. The sailing, port order and times come from Virgin Voyages' own itinerary page for this voyage. Nothing is inherited from the v0.1.3 Sisters at Sea sidecar (a different ship and sailing); every claim was looked up again. Where only a search snippet of a page could be read, the entry says [SNIPPET] and the pack leaves the number out or tells the reader to check it.
verified_by: Claude Code session for operator Ken Baker

gross_tonnage.notes: Fincantieri's builder sheet for the four Lady ships. Wikipedia infobox also 110,000. Virgin's ships page labels it 'Weight 110,000t', which conflates volume and weight; the pack explains gross tonnage as volume.

length.notes: Fincantieri: 'Length overall (m) 277.2'. Virgin's March 2026 release rounds to 'A 900-foot ship'.

guests.value: 2,770 Sailors (Virgin fleet figure); no double-occupancy figure published
guests.quote: Our ships can host 2,770 Sailors and 1,160 amazing Crew from around the world.
guests.notes: Virgin's ships page says 'Max. sailors 2,762'. The pack calls 2,770 a fleet figure.

crew.notes: Fact sheet 1,160; ships page 'Crew members 1,150'. The pack states the range and says two Virgin pages differ.

decks.value: 17 per Wikipedia and CruiseMapper (secondary); no official Virgin figure found. The pack names only Decks 6, 7, 8, 16 and 17 from Virgin's own FAQ text and states no total

builder.value: Fincantieri, hull 6304; Wikipedia names the Sestri Ponente (Genoa) yard
builder.notes: Builder sheet confirms 'Brilliant Lady 2023 Hull 6304'. The pack says 'Fincantieri, Italy' and does not name the yard.

in_service.value: September 2025 from New York; first Miami arrival October 2025
in_service.quote: Brilliant Lady launched in September 2025 from New York City.
in_service.notes: Miami arrival: Virgin press release of Sept 15, 2025 ('on Oct. 17, she'll ... make her highly anticipated Miami arrival'). Delivery date not published by the builder beyond the year.

panama_canal_modifications.value: Lifeboat davits moved inboard and the Deck 7 aft overhang removed so she can transit the canal; LA to Miami canal voyage departs Oct 29 2026
panama_canal_modifications.quote: departs Oct. 29, 2026, sailing from Los Angeles to Miami on a 17-night voyage
panama_canal_modifications.notes: Modification wording from Virgin's March 26, 2026 release: 'Brilliant Lady's three sister ships were never able to transit the Panama Canal ... a custom davit system ... removed the aft overhang on Deck 7 entirely'.

imo.notes: Wikipedia infobox and CruiseMapper agree (MMSI 311001167 in both).

hull_art.value: Mermaid artwork by Toronto illustrator Janice Sung

godparent.value: Not named in any primary source checked
godparent.notes: Wikipedia 'christened' field is blank; Virgin's press archive 2023-2026 names no godmother. Search-engine summaries claim Jennifer Lopez; not found on any primary page, so not used.

auto_gratuity_rate.value: Bookings from Oct 7 2025: $22 per Sailor per night added on board, or $20 per night if pre-paid; may be modified at Sailor Services if paid on board
auto_gratuity_rate.quote: Starting October 7, 2025, ... we automatically apply a daily service gratuity of $22 USD per Sailor to your onboard folio. Prefer to take care of it in advance? Pre-pay before the voyage begins and pay just $20 USD per night.
auto_gratuity_rate.notes: CONFLICT: Virgin's drinks page still says 'all tips on us'; CruiseMapper says gratuities are included. Both out of date. The pack tells the reader to ask Tina whether her group fare includes them.

laundry_availability.value: No self-service launderette; full laundry service for a charge
laundry_availability.quote: While we don't have a self-service launderette on board, we do offer full laundry service

all_aboard.notes: Shore FAQ: 'We recommend arriving back to the ship an hour before the scheduled departure time.'

included.value: 20+ restaurants, entertainment, Wi-Fi (tier by fare), fitness classes, soda and water
included.quote: Every fare gets the Virgin Voyages magic: 20+ restaurants, award-winning entertainment, WiFi (that actually works), unlimited fitness classes, soda & water (including sparkling water!)

dining_exceptions_and_shipeats.value: Treat Yourself items and the dinner shows Another Rose and It's a Ship Show cost extra; ShipEats $10 delivery, waived on orders of $10 or more
dining_exceptions_and_shipeats.notes: Reservation windows by fare (15 days Base to 60 days Premium, 120 for RockStar) from the same FAQ.

bar_tab.value: Pre-purchased onboard credit for drinks on board and at the Bimini Beach Club; buy until 24 hours before sailing; not refundable; no drink packages

adults_only.value: Minimum age to book and sail 18

dress.value: 'Dress Up. Dress Down. Just Dress.'; Scarlet Night red theme

smoking.value: Only in The Smoking Room (Deck 6 forward) and a designated area on Deck 16; $500 fee elsewhere including vaping
smoking.notes: Fleet-wide FAQ; deck numbers not confirmed ship by ship.

irons.quote: Clothing irons are a no go on board

travel_documents.value: Passport valid at least 6 months after voyage end; closed-loop alternatives for some Miami round trips
travel_documents.notes: The pack advises a passport valid through June 10, 2027, and notes the BVI's own passport requirement.

solo.value: Solo Insider cabins 'designed and priced exclusively for the solo traveler'; solo meetups (Evening Meet-Up, Morning Meet-Up, 'Let's Set Sail')
solo.notes: Solo Insider wording from the 2025 fact sheet. Size, count and decks for Brilliant Lady not published; 'no single supplement' not stated by Virgin and not claimed.

rojo.value: Rojo by Razzle Dazzle, only on Brilliant Lady
rojo.quote: Rojo by Razzle Dazzle – only on Brilliant Lady

juice_sea.value: Juice Sea, wellness bar on Deck 7

slightly_smaller_sea_terrace.value: Mid-ship Deck 8 balconies reconfigured, two hammocks
slightly_smaller_sea_terrace.notes: From the March 26, 2026 release on the canal refit.

shows.value: Disco Circus, Up With a Twist, Murder in the Manor, Duets, Electric, Red Hot, Out of Time, The Diva Goes West
shows.notes: Whether Up With a Twist carries a charge on this ship is unverified; the pack says to check the app.

restaurants_linked.value: Razzle Dazzle, Pink Agave, Extra Virgin, Gunbae, The Test Kitchen, The Wake, The Galley, The Pizza Place, Lick Me Till Ice Cream (fleet list on cruise-dining)

sailing.value: Eastern Caribbean & Bimini Beach Club, voyage BR26113010NDP, Mon Nov 30 to Thu Dec 10 2026, Miami round trip
sailing.notes: The page shows one schedule for three dates (Nov 30 2026, Jan 11 2027, Mar 8 2027); the pack tells the reader to check times in the app. Weekdays computed in-session.

port_times.value: Miami dep 5:00 PM; Philipsburg 8 AM-6 PM; Tortola 9 AM-6 PM; St. Croix 8 AM-6 PM; San Juan 8 AM-5 PM; Puerto Plata 10 AM-7 PM; Bimini 9 AM-6 PM; Miami arr 6:30 AM (allow up to an hour for the gangway)
port_times.notes: iCruise agrees. An AI search summary giving 9-5 at every port was wrong and is not used.

miami_terminal.value: Terminal V, 718 N. Cruise Blvd; GPS 1015 North America Way; luggage drop from 9am; boarding generally from about 2:15 pm by app arrival time
miami_terminal.notes: GPS address from Virgin's story page; 2:15 pm from the port-information FAQ.

miami_parking.notes: CONFLICT: Virgin's undated story page says $22; it points readers to PortMiami for current rates. The pack uses PortMiami's figure.

mia_distance_and_taxi.value: About 9 miles; metered taxis, $15 minimum from MIA or the port

hurricane_season.value: June 1 to November 30; activity 'sometimes occurs' after the official dates

st_maarten_walk.value: About 10 minutes on foot from the port to town
st_maarten_walk.notes: Hotel and tourism association page; snippets say 20 minutes. Pier name not verified.

st_maarten_taxi.value: From the cruise port, 1-2 people: Philipsburg $10, Maho $25, airport $25; 3-5 people per person: Philipsburg $4, Maho $9; 25% surcharge 10 PM-6 AM and holidays

st_maarten_rainforest.value: Sky Explorer from $59; Flying Dutchman from $109

st_maarten_money_emergency.value: USD accepted; Caribbean guilder (XCG) since March 2025; police 911, ambulance 912
st_maarten_money_emergency.notes: Ambulance 912 also on https://www.sintmaartengov.org/Ministries/Departments/Pages/Ambulance.aspx. The travel-tips page still names the old Antillean florin; the XCG change date is from a snippet of the central bank's release.

tortola_pier_and_taxi.value: Road Town cruise pier, Pier Park at the pier, 10-15 min walk; two large ships, a third tenders; Cane Garden Bay taxi $10-16 per person
tortola_pier_and_taxi.notes: Walk time and taxi: https://www.cruisehive.com/tortola-cruise-port/145549 (updated 2026-09-21). Virgin's page does not name the berth.

tortola_ferry.value: Road Town Fast Ferry, Mon-Sat: Road Town to Virgin Gorda 10:00 AM among others; Virgin Gorda to Road Town 1:30 PM among others

st_croix_pier.notes: Virgin's St. Croix page: 'Frederiksted (where the ship will be docked)'.

st_croix_sites.value: Fort Frederik $5, 16 and under free with an adult; Buck Island no entry fee, boats from Christiansted, 40 min to 1.5 hr; Big Beard's half day $95; Christiansted NHS $10 for 16+, card only

Christiansted: https://www.nps.gov/chri/planyourvisit/fees.htm. Big Beard's: https://www.bigbeards.com/tours/. NPS fee page bodies dated 2023.

usvi_basics.value: US dollar; no passport for US citizens; drive on the left

puerto_plata_facts.value: Fortaleza San Felipe 16th century; cable car closed June 2024, rebuild from Oct 2026, reopening targeted Q1 2028; peso, dollars at a worse rate; 911; no e-ticket for cruise passengers
puerto_plata_facts.notes: Cable car: https://deultimominuto.com/nacionales/remozamiento-teleferico-puerto-plata/ and https://www.arecoa.com/destinos/2026/09/30/remozamiento-del-teleferico-de-puerto-plata-arranca-el-proximo-sabado/. Money and 911: https://www.godominicanrepublic.com/travel/travel-tips. E-ticket: https://www.godominicanrepublic.com/travel/entry-requirements.

bimini_beach_club.value: Free tram from the cruise dock; included: Wi-Fi, pools, loungers, lockers, showers, Bahamian food, soda and water, morning yoga; extra: cocktails (Bar Tab), cabanas, Airstreams, Shore Things
bimini_beach_club.quote: Free tram shuttles run every few minutes between the cruise dock and the Beach Club.
bimini_beach_club.notes: CONFLICT: an independent fan blog says tender; Virgin's page says dock. The pack follows Virgin.

advisories.value: Sint Maarten Level 1 (2024-08-18); Bahamas Level 2 (2026-07-27, crime mostly Nassau and Freeport); Dominican Republic Level 2 (2025-06-11); BVI Level 1 (2026-05-21)
advisories.notes: State Department data feed; the same values are in admin/voyage-pwa/alerts.json built from it today.

emergency_lines.notes: OCS numbers from Virgin's security guide PDF (2022) and a travel.state.gov snippet; they match every earlier pack that read them on the page. Embassy and consulate phone numbers deliberately NOT printed: found only in Virgin's 2020 and 2022 security PDFs (one still says 'Netherland Antilles'); the official sites returned 403. A '+1-833-624-0944' 'ship to shore' number appears only on third-party pages and is called out in the pack as one to avoid, without printing it.

group_fares.value: Solo price: Interior $1,715; Balcony $2,316; 'Prices subject to change until booking is made.'
group_fares.notes: Maulsby Travel Co. flyer, read in-session. Difference $601 computed. Gratuities: $220 / $200 for 10 nights computed from Virgin's per-night rates.

weather_normals.method: Open-Meteo historical weather API (default archive model), daily temperature_2m_max/min and precipitation_sum at each stop's coordinates, Nov 30 - Dec 10, years 2020-2024 (55 days per stop), simple mean; wet day = precipitation_sum > 1.0 mm. Fetched as one 2020-11-30 to 2024-12-10 span per stop and filtered to the window, after the per-year requests hit Open-Meteo's rate limit; same data, fewer requests.

preship_review.class_E: Every price labeled October 2026; the budget section says they change.
preship_review.class_H: No drink calculator link (Virgin has no packages; README tool matrix skips it for Virgin). No stateroom check link (Virgin ships are not in its picker).

cluster_detection.notes: Layer 2: the template's repeated 'Things to know' sub-heads. Counter-signals: dated first-person boundary, sourced numbers with dates, explicit refusals to print unsourced figures, and sailing-specific timing (San Juan's 4:00 PM all-aboard, the Tortola ferry window).
